notes.title: Fatal Hour: Roadkill as a expansion!
notes.notes: Now almost for free.!  We have made a decsions to have a heavily reduced price on Roadkill for the people who enjoyed Petroleum and wants a diffrent experience. An offensive game instead of a defensive one!

notes.title: Go on and get it! :)
notes.notes:
Finally we released the second minigame in the Fatal Hour series! Hope you all enjoy the little backstory we put in and stay put for the upcoming game!


Best Regards

Kristoffer
